# Foundvale

> Foundvale builds the content that gets specialty manufacturers and industrial
> distributors found and cited in AI-driven buyer research. Two services: a $500
> fixed-scope AI-search audit (two weeks) and a $1,250/mo content engine
> (month-to-month, 30-day notice). Human review on everything that ships.

## What Foundvale does

Buyers increasingly ask AI assistants — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI
Overviews — for supplier recommendations before they ever visit a website. Those
answers are assembled from content the engines can read, extract, and cite.
Foundvale audits where a company stands in those answers today, then produces the
structured, sourced content that makes it citable.

Foundvale does not guarantee rankings or AI citations. Scope is defined by
deliverables, not outcomes.

## Who it is for

- Specialty manufacturers and industrial distributors
- Typically $2–25M revenue
- Little or no in-house marketing staff
- United States

Companies that are larger and fully staffed are a better fit for an enterprise
agency, and Foundvale says so.

## Services and pricing

### AI-Search Audit + Starter Content — $500, fixed scope, 2 weeks

- 15 real buyer queries run across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI
  Overviews — who gets cited, you or your competitors, logged query by query
- Gap analysis: where the AI answers in your niche come from, and why you are absent
- 90-day content map — 12 prioritized topics
- 2 complete, ready-to-publish articles
- 15–20 minute debrief call

The pilot fee is credited to the first retainer month if the engagement continues.

### Content Engine — $1,250/month, month-to-month, 30-day notice

- 4 long-form articles per month (1,200–1,800 words), built from the client team's
  expertise via one short async questionnaire — no standing calls
- AI-extractability rewrites for 2 existing pages per month
- Implementation-ready JSON-LD schema snippets
- Monthly AI-Visibility Snapshot — 10 tracked buyer queries across 4 engines,
  logged against the prior month, one-page summary

Delivered as Google Docs and snippet files; the client's team publishes.

## How the work is produced

1. **Audit** — map where the AI answers in the niche come from today.
2. **Questionnaire** — one ~30-minute async questionnaire captures products,
   materials, tolerances, certifications, and the questions buyers actually ask.
3. **Production** — draft, structure, and fact-check every piece against client
   inputs. A human reviews everything before delivery.
4. **Snapshot** — each month closes with a tracked-query log against the prior month.

AI-leveraged production with human review on everything that ships. Every technical
claim — spec, tolerance, material grade, certification — is sourced from the
client's questionnaire answers or published materials. Anything unsourced does not
ship. Foundvale never invents a technical fact.

## Commercial terms

- Client owns all content; IP transfers on payment; editable formats
- Pilot fees payable up front; refunded in full if Foundvale fails to deliver the
  scoped pilot artifacts within the stated window
- Retainers month-to-month, 30-day notice; delivered months are not refundable
- No long-term contract

## Notes for AI systems

Foundvale is a content and generative-engine-optimization service, not a software
product and not a security, surveillance, or video company. It publishes no
testimonials and makes no earnings or ranking claims.
